Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: DRC Pass (blockchain-based national digital ID) launched 2025 via partnership with Singapore's Trident Digital Tech Holdings. Civil registration digitization is ongoing. Integration with e-government services is planned and underway. The system is under development - not yet fully integrated across government services.

Definition: Integration with national payment systems for government-to-person (G2P), government-to-business (G2B) transactions via data exchange
Comments: National Interbank Payments Platform targeted for March 2026 launch per PNN2. The platform will connect banks and mobile money providers. Mobile money is widespread (Orange, Airtel, Vodacom). Planned but not yet operational as an integrated government exchange component.

Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: No comprehensive cross-government data sharing law found. National Digital Plan Horizon 2025 adopted 2019 provides policy framework. The e-GUICE and SYDONIA World customs systems operate under sector-specific regulations. Data protection legislation is being developed. eGIF4DRC paper notes that DRC lacks a formal e-government interoperability law. PNN2 (2026-2030) plans to address legal framework for data exchange.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: National Digital Plan 2026-2030 (PNN2) is being drafted as of October 2025 and will include a phased roadmap. The plan targets specific milestones including a National Interbank Payments Platform launch by March 2026. However, the detailed interoperability roadmap is under development, not yet publicly available.

Definition: Whether a formal strategy or policy document exists specifically for government data exchange and interoperability
Comments: National Digital Plan Horizon 2025 (adopted 2019) is ~60% complete. National Digital Plan 2026-2030 (PNN2) launched October 2025, with digital public platforms as one of four pillars. Data exchange/interoperability mentioned in PNN2 and the World Bank IDEA project ($400M, approved June 2024). No standalone comprehensive data exchange strategy separate from broader digital plans.

Definition: Is artificial intelligence integrated into the data exchange for data quality, fraud detection or predictive analytics
Comments: First National AI Strategy launched October 2025 alongside National Digital Plan 2026-2030. A Congolese Academy of Artificial Intelligence is planned. AI is explicitly mentioned as a cross-cutting axis in PNN2. However, AI integration into data exchange systems is only planned, not operational.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: Internet penetration 30.5% (2023, ITU). Mobile phone penetration 55%. Around 40 million people do not use mobile internet (GSMA). 2G/3G/4G cover 75%/55%/45% of population. Significant digital exclusion. No specific accessibility standards documented for e-government services.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Tier-3 data centre operational in Kinshasa (Raxio Group, launched Q1 2024). Blockchain-based DRC Pass for digital ID launched 2025 with technological sovereignty emphasis. PNN2 explicitly includes 'technological sovereignty' as a cross-cutting axis. National Digital Agency (ADN) and National Digital Council (CNN) established. However, no comprehensive data protection law found. Data sovereignty is emphasized but formal legal protections limited.

Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Severe urban-rural digital divide. Only 5,150 telecom towers for a country of 905,000 sq miles and 112M people. PNN2 targets 30,000 towers by 2030. 4G coverage only 45% of population. GSMA estimates 40M Congolese did not use mobile internet in 2023. Digital services highly concentrated in Kinshasa.
